label: AI Insight UI — Smart City
info:
Smart City data backend, REAL data only. All application traffic flows over
UIBUILDER §9 (link-from-ui-smart-city → fn_smart_city_fap_route → fn_trino_run_fap
→ link-response-smart-city → link-from-response). The HTTP routes under
/api/v1/{streetlights,traffic,events,city-weather}/... are scheduled for removal
after the §9 path is verified end-to-end.

FAP §9 actions:
  smart-city.zones.list           — distinct zones
  smart-city.zones.detail         — recent observations for a zone
  smart-city.streetlights.list    — fleet rollup, hourly
  smart-city.streetlights.current — latest hourly row for a 'light' (zone_id)
  smart-city.streetlights.history — last 24h hourly
  smart-city.traffic.zones        — distinct zones
  smart-city.traffic.current      — latest hourly row
  smart-city.traffic.history      — last 24h hourly
  smart-city.traffic.summary      — 24h aggregate per zone
  smart-city.events.zones         — distinct zones
  smart-city.events.current       — latest event row for a zone
  smart-city.events.history       — last 30 days
  smart-city.events.recent        — last 7 days, all active zones
  smart-city.weather.current      — latest hour
  smart-city.weather.history      — last 24h

All queries hit Trino's gold layer:
  gold.streetlight_zone_hourly  · gold.traffic_pattern_hourly
  gold.event_impact_daily       · gold.weather_hourly

If a Trino query returns no rows the response carries
metadata.note='no rows in window' and an empty payload — never synthesised data
(FAP §10 design rule 4 + §12 mandatory rule).

name: smart-city.* FAP — route + prepare SQL
execute Trino + shape FAP result
